description: Numerical simulation and evacuation strategy planning for flood disasters in metro stations is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Zhiwei Dai. Metro stations, characterized by enclosed spatial configurations, are highly vulnerable to extreme flooding, posing severe threats to human life and property. Understanding the hydrodynamic processes of flood intrusion and their implications for pedestrian evacuation is used in urban flood risk reduction. However, evacuation processes within flooded metro stations have received relatively limited attention. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 202524139 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
